(1) A01 pre-counted shot: in r3's supabase/migrations/20260908120000_offline_device_grants.sql the ledger trigger guard_offline_ledger_event() (r3 lines 375-385) and consume_offline_ticket() (r3 lines 893-902) accepted any scored, permit-less shot of the same user — with no relation between the shot's timestamp and the ticket's allocation. A rating already counted by lifetime_scored_count() before the ticket existed could 'consume' the ticket: hold → 0, a second issue_offline_grant() minted a new ticket, so tickets-ever-allocated + counted shots = 3 against the 2-rating budget.
(2) A02 late-linked identity: ownership (r3 offline_ticket_owned_by(uuid,text[],uuid), lines 299-316, callers at 365/782/876) and offline_hold_count() (r3 line 408) used only the identity_hashes snapshot stored on the 'allocated' ledger row. 20260905000100_late_linked_identity_ledger.sql:33-77 propagates the free-rating COUNT at link time but nothing propagated the HOLD, so an identity linked after the allocation, then account deletion + re-creation with only that identity, saw hold=0 and got 2 fresh tickets (4 outstanding for one holder). BASE_SHA itself has none of the W04 objects (the SQL matrix on base fails at the first reference to public.offline_allocation_ledger).

FIX (all inside write_paths, wired into the shipping SQL RPC/trigger path):
- Temporal chargeability: both guard_offline_ledger_event() (line 524) and consume_offline_ticket() (line 1036) now additionally require s.created_at >= v_allocation.created_at (the allocation row). A rating that predates the ticket is 'offline.shot_not_chargeable' via RPC and check_violation at the table; the hold stays; the refresh re-issues the same ticket; online reservation stays paywalled.
- Late-link inheritance: new append-only table public.offline_allocation_identity_links (line 290; RLS on, no policies, no client/service grants, no FKs, sequence revoked, guard_offline_ledger_append_only reused — generalised to '% is append-only', tg_table_name). guard_offline_identity_link BEFORE INSERT refuses a ticket the linking account does not own. api_private.offline_owned_allocations(uid) (line 367) = ledger rows owned by account or allocation-time hashes ∪ link rows for the caller's current hashes; offline_ticket_owned_by() gained a ticket_id argument and consults the links; offline_hold_count(), issue/consume/release RPCs and the ledger guard all go through these. public.inherit_offline_allocation_holds() (line 427) runs as AFTER INSERT trigger offline_holds_on_identity_link on auth.identities (line 453) and links every outstanding (not consumed/released) owned ticket to the newly linked identity hash. Released tickets are not re-credited; nothing is reclaimed.
- Trigger named offline_holds_on_identity_link (not *on_auth_identity_linked*) so the existing static pin that guards 20260905000100's on_auth_identity_linked trigger is not tripped; that trigger is untouched.
